title: Separate identity, provenance, and verification
description: Store and present product identity, source provenance, and physical-verification status as independent values so catalog inclusion or published dimensions never imply measurement evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Product identity fields are stored independently from source provenance
Source provenance identifies origin and citation details without changing physical-verification state
Physical-verification status is explicit and defaults to unverified when no qualifying evidence exists
Catalog inclusion never sets or labels a layout as physically verified
The editor displays identity, provenance, and physical verification as three separately labeled groups
Unknown, unverified, and verified states are not communicated by color alone

steps.details: Create separate serializable types for product identifiers, source provenance, and physical-verification status; require evidence references only for a verified variant.
Store identity and provenance on the stable sheet layout and verification disclosure at its defined ownership boundary without deriving one field from another.
Display descriptive headings and values for Product identity, Source provenance, and Physical verification, including text labels for unknown or unverified states.
Ensure catalog import/create paths assign provenance but leave physical verification unverified unless a later evidence workflow supplies qualifying records.
Test combinations of catalog/manual provenance and missing verification, then assert UI labels and durable values remain independent after reload.

technicalNotes: Published product dimensions are source data, not physical evidence.
No current physical materials can support a verified status under TASK-1.
